name: pixel-tunes
description: A pixel-art Spotify player in a pane next to your chat, with a scene that fits the music

spotify_client_id.title: Spotify Client ID
spotify_client_id.description: The Client ID of your own app in the Spotify Developer Dashboard (no secret needed). The README explains how to make one.

callback_port.title: Port for the login callback
callback_port.description: The port in your redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:<port>/callback

genre_lookup.title: Look up genres on MusicBrainz
genre_lookup.description: Looks up the genres of the playing artist on musicbrainz.org to choose the scene. For that, the artist's Spotify ID, or else the ISRC code of the track, goes to musicbrainz.org.
